title: 2019-20 Optic #71 Khris Middleton Milwaukee Bucks Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Showcase your love for basketball and the Milwaukee Bucks by owning the 2019-20 Optic Blue Velocity #71 Khris Middleton trading card. With its stunning blue parallel design, this original Panini card is made of high-quality card stock and features Middleton in his Bucks uniform. This card is part of the 2019-20 set and manufactured in the United States.

The card's aspects include its standard size, English language, and NBA league. This card is not autographed and is not a custom bundle. It is a sports trading card and part of the Optic parallel/variety. The card is an excellent addition to your collection of sports trading cards and is perfect for showcasing your love for the Milwaukee Bucks.
